title: Curated official NEET-UG question bank
description: A small, browser-ready bank of official NEET-UG 2020 English booklet E1 questions, paired with the final NTA answer key. The selection favors text-only items that render reliably in the visual essay.

source.rights_note: Official-source material. This repository does not claim ownership or relicense the questions.
